decisions.reason: The green startup accelerator has been featured on the home page in both years and is a low-cost, visible signal of the sustainability direction the firm has announced, so management will persist with it despite unclear returns.

The CO2-negative bitumen binder still has its own page and fits the firm's announced climate-positive mission, and its slow uptake can be blamed on long approval cycles in road construction, so the firm keeps investing.

The WASTX Cleanic is the publicly announced flagship of the Biofabrik–ERMAFA partnership and is promoted prominently as the first of a series, so it carries strong public commitment and invested resources that make dropping it very unlikely.
